summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K announcing the second tranche of its share buyback program, executed under EU MAR and Delegated Regulation 2016/1052, with the aim of reducing share capital by cancelling repurchased shares. The maximum cash outlay is EUR 1,000 million, capped at 507,759,303 shares, starting 14 October 2026 and ending between 7 January and 4 February 2027, with possible postponement to 18 February 2027 for excluded days. J.P. Morgan SE will independently manage purchases on the Continuous Market and Cboe Europe, Turquoise Europe and Aquis Exchange, respecting a 25% daily volume limit per venue. Watch execution pace and capital reduction impact; no risk-arb angle.
